name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 review correction

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-review-fix

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  correct-and-recertify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EOS_ACTOR: eos-evidence-refresh
    steps:
      - name: Check out current PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: wp/mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify expected starting head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "7a24c4e5bd5696e1a69afc5cf2a3b4dddc8daeb3"

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Apply bounded source-range path correction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path

          path = Path('crates/monad-core/src/config.rs')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

          replacements = [
              (
                  'use std::{collections::BTreeMap, str};',
                  'use std::{collections::BTreeMap, fmt::Write as _, str};',
              ),
              (
                  '    for (name, values) in &spanned.artifacts {\n        let path = format!("artifacts.{name}");',
                  '    for (name, values) in &spanned.artifacts {\n        let path = format!("artifacts.{}", encode_path_segment(name));',
              ),
          ]

          for old, new in replacements:
              if text.count(old) != 1:
                  raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one occurrence of: {old!r}')
              text = text.replace(old, new, 1)

          marker = '''fn insert_range<T>(\n    ranges: &mut BTreeMap<String, SourceRange>,\n'''
          helper = '''fn encode_path_segment(segment: &str) -> String {\n    let mut encoded = String::with_capacity(segment.len());\n    for byte in segment.as_bytes() {\n        match byte {\n            b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z' | b'0'..=b'9' | b'_' | b'-' => {\n                encoded.push(char::from(*byte));\n            }\n            byte => {\n                write!(&mut encoded, "%{byte:02X}")\n                    .expect("writing percent-encoded path segment to String cannot fail");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    encoded\n}\n\n'''
          if text.count(marker) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('insert_range marker was not unique')
          text = text.replace(marker, helper + marker, 1)

          old_test = '''        let schema = &document.source_ranges["schema_version"];\n        assert_eq!(&VALID[schema.start_byte..schema.end_byte], "1");\n    }\n'''
          new_test = '''        let schema = &document.source_ranges["schema_version"];\n        assert_eq!(&VALID[schema.start_byte..schema.end_byte], "1");\n\n        let colliding_names = r#"schema_version = 1\n[project]\nid = "range-collision"\nname = "Range Collision"\n\n[artifacts]\nfoo = ["a"]\n"foo[0]" = ["b"]\n"#;\n        let colliding_effective =\n            parse_effective_configuration(colliding_names, &CliOverrides::default())\n                .expect("effective colliding artifact names");\n        let colliding_document =\n            parse_monad_configuration(colliding_names.as_bytes(), &colliding_effective)\n                .expect("parse colliding artifact names");\n        let foo_item = &colliding_document.source_ranges["artifacts.foo[0]"];\n        assert_eq!(\n            &colliding_names[foo_item.start_byte..foo_item.end_byte],\n            "\\\"a\\\""\n        );\n        let escaped_artifact =\n            &colliding_document.source_ranges["artifacts.foo%5B0%5D"];\n        assert_eq!(\n            &colliding_names[escaped_artifact.start_byte..escaped_artifact.end_byte],\n            "[\\\"b\\\"]"\n        );\n        let escaped_item =\n            &colliding_document.source_ranges["artifacts.foo%5B0%5D[0]"];\n        assert_eq!(\n            &colliding_names[escaped_item.start_byte..escaped_item.end_byte],\n            "\\\"b\\\""\n        );\n    }\n'''
          if text.count(old_test) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('range regression insertion point was not unique')
          text = text.replace(old_test, new_test, 1)

          path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Format and validate corrected product source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test -p monad-core 2>&1 | tee /tmp/monad-core-tests.log
          grep -Eq 'test result: ok\. 131 passed; 0 failed' /tmp/monad-core-tests.log
          cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::large_enum_variant
          git diff --check -- crates/monad-core/src/

      - name: Synchronize source projections before recertification
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Recertify shared predecessor verification scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          for target in WP-MVP-0001 WP-MVP-0002 WP-MVP-0003 WP-MVP-0004; do
            ./scripts/eos validate "$target" --profile wp
          done

      - name: Regenerate settled governed projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify corrected combined tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Publish corrected PR head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git add crates/monad-core/src/config.rs .eos engineering/evidence machine
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "Unexpected unstaged changes outside bounded correction/evidence/projection paths:" >&2
            git status --short >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "fix(core): disambiguate config source-range paths"
          git push origin HEAD:wp/mvp-0005
